title: Notes must agree at the joins.
body: the-bound-book · The cards of a whole course fold shut into one bound book whose spine carries a tick, and the exam pod answers ✓.

title: Give each note its own card.
body: nowhere-to-hide · The same tray, but the cards now stand at their own heights and the once hidden wrong link glows red in plain view as the whale circles it.

title: Keep the red join red.
body: red-stays-red · The paint roller is set down, the red light stays red, and an owner pod arrives. The board is honest, and the client is no longer surprised.

title: Map the joins, then merge.
body: map-then-merge · The same drop as the cold open, made after the map: the one bad join is fixed first, the folder lands, and every thread holds.

title: Show both sides of the edge.
body: both-cards-kept · The two clashing cards both land on the join with their labels, nothing sinks, and the pod checks both before answering ✓.

title: One owner for every join.
body: owner-ticks · Every shared piece carries its owner tick, every copy matches, and the output ships to a pod that answers ✓.

title: Seven opinions, one line.
body: ring-settles · Seven clashing chips slide together and the ring of pods closes into one smooth line around the whale, then a checker compares it against the books.

title: Keep both. Mark the join.
body: old-card-surfaces · The overwritten card rises back from under the line, takes its place beside the new one, and the assistant answers correctly from it.

title: Test the gate by breaking it.
body: planted-break-bounces · The crooked card that once slid through is fired at the same gate and bounces off red, while the reader pod answers ✓.

title: Trust the parts that agree.
body: solid-and-dashed · The answer line reads at a glance: solid teal where parts fit, one dashed copper gap where the made-up part sits, and the whale steps over it.

title: Fold only the joins that agree.
body: gold-trunk · The FELT handover replays. Both disagreeing cards stay visible at a terracotta join while the agreeing joins fold into a gold trunk above.

title: Odd joins wait for a person.
body: the-waiting-chair · The bent card from bar 1 now waits on the side branch beside the person chip while the bundle ships clean, then rejoins after a tick.

title: Every push meets the gate.
body: bounce-at-the-door · The same bad card bounces off the gate at the landing spot, the shared line stays clean, and the pods keep reading.

title: Let every join pull back.
body: settle-home · The FELT nudge replays, and now the touching joins pull the knot back into its outline every time, even under a harder push.

title: Floppy parts have fewer joins.
body: wobble-wash · A warm-to-cool wash appears over the same still knot, and the whale props its pods on the cool end, where they stay.

title: See every link below the top.
body: fog-lifts · The same top row, but with the rows below now in view: the tiny crack is seen early and patched before anything above sags.

title: Credit should flow down the links.
body: credit-rain · The thanks that stopped at the top now rains on down every link to the little library, which brightens and lowers its flag.

title: Draw only links you can show.
body: honest-map · The diagram is redrawn in the same spot with fewer arrows, the core box standing alone, and gaps in their own colour; every pod arrives somewhere real.

title: Let the unfinished joins glow.
body: holes-that-glow · The same status board, now honest: known gaps glow terracotta, the pods stop and route around them, and none falls.

title: Rules on top, parts below.
body: four-shelves · The same crate tips, but every card drops onto its shelf as it lands, and the pod walks straight through, row by row.

title: A wiki with pins.
body: link-lands · The new-hire whale follows the same thread from the same dot and lands on a pinned dot. The pod that answered with a cross now answers with a tick.

title: Merge, and keep the seams.
body: two-pods-agree · The two pods that got opposite answers ask again. Both read the marked box and give the same answer with the same note.

title: The same mistake, pinned.
body: third-time-bounces · The same smudge arrives a third time at the same spot, hits the new pin and bounces off while the whale stays still.

title: Don't touch the gate.
body: gate-wont-budge · The same pod meets the same gate at the same hard bend, cannot move the gate, and rebuilds the bend so the gate opens honestly.

title: We choose the pins.
body: label-honestly · The same pin is shown to the same reviewer, now without a halo and with a chip reading Chosen, then checked. The reviewer answers with a tick.

title: Try first. Then the gate opens.
body: earned-card · The answer card waits behind the gate. The whale's own worked line reaches it and matches it, then the next-day puzzle is passed.

title: Find the pin first.
body: turn-and-see · One turn of the original tangle finds the still point, the pin drops, and the tangle unwinds into a calm line in one pass.

title: Small changes, one counter.
body: ghost-overlay · The ghost of the original line returns beside the edited line. After a quarter of edits the two nearly match, and the bar has room left.

title: AI writes. The gate checks.
body: the-short-list · Same morning, same whale. Instead of a towering pile, a neat line and a short stack of two flagged batches wait for a human decision.

title: Two copies, one seam.
body: rails-in-step · The same one-sided edit now makes its seam glow until the doc follows, and the two rails curve together through a long bend.

title: Give every note a label.
body: draft-stays-out · The same two look-alike cards return in the FELT framing, now tabbed yellow and slate. The pod reaches in; only the slate socket opens to it, the draft drifts aside, and its answer chip shows a tick.

title: Hand over only the right cards.
body: rule-on-top · FELT framing: the whale and the same pod. Instead of a drawer, a short stack slides over with the small rule card on top; the pod answers, nothing is circled, its chip shows a tick.

title: One fact at every joint.
body: twin-ticks · FELT framing: the two pods face each other across the fork. Their chips flip to the same tick at the same moment, and the two halves of work meet and join with no gap.

title: Private cards stay home.
body: sealed-card-stays · FELT framing: the whale copies last week's brief again and the other firm's pod swims in. The violet card stays behind at the closed gate; the pod reads, nothing is circled, its chip shows a tick.

title: Send the wiring, not the pile.
body: pack-clears-the-cut · FELT framing: the same pod and the same cut line at its mouth. The small wiring pack slides in and the cut falls on open water; nothing is sliced, the pod answers with a tick.

title: Draw the sockets first.
body: two-roots-merge · FELT framing: the two result cards side by side, as in bar 2. They slide together and become one identical card with a teal tick.

title: See every joint first.
body: one-ripple · FELT framing: the whale nudges the same small card. One arrow lights to its single neighbour, whose pod blinks once and stays green; the other four pods keep their ticks.

title: Add the missing piece.
body: flow-through-join · FELT framing: the same join where the line cracked. Now a steady stream of cards flows across the converter without a crack, and the pod downstream answers with a tick.

title: Each helper gets its own part.
body: three-stretches-close · FELT framing: the same stretch where the scribble formed. Three pods write side by side in their own stretches; the joints tick and the stretches close into one clean line.

title: Find the joint that slipped.
body: the-lit-joint · FELT framing: the whale over the same tree, the root wrong again. This time one joint lights at once and the whale swims straight to it.

title: Build it once, with slots.
body: blank-paper-stays-filled · The FELT close shot returns: the same paper, the same finished line. A third client arrives; only its cards change colour in one beat; the line stays.

title: Stop when the counter hits zero.
body: counter-says-stop · FELT close shot: the whale lifts a fin to tweak again, sees the counter at 0, and lets go. The line holds; a pod answers ✓.

title: Send only what clears the gate.
body: two-lines-now-differ · FELT close shot of the two look-alike lines; now each wears its ring score. One sits under the mark, one above. The whale sends only the one above; pod ✓.

title: One line for every puzzle.
body: four-cards-four-ticks · FELT close shot: the same four puzzle cards from bar 1 slide along the one line; four ticks land in a row, on the beat.

title: Every try gets a tick.
body: tap-the-tick-restore · FELT close shot after many reshapes; the whale taps the tick with the ✓ and the exact line from bar 2 snaps back; pod ✓.

title: A small gate picks the road.
body: tiny-question-short-road · FELT close shot: the same tiny line meets the gate, takes the short road and is answered ✓ in one beat; the cost counter barely moves.

title: Check every join in the chain.
body: calm-to-the-last-step · FELT close shot of the five segments: now calm from first to last, every seam ticked; the pod at the end answers ✓.

title: Keep the judge pinned.
body: the-post-wont-budge · FELT close shot of the same gate: the whale shoves a post; pinned, it does not move. The whale reshapes the line instead; the counter rises honestly; pod ✓.

title: One change, then measure.
body: one-kink-per-beat · FELT close shot of the six-kink line: kinks smooth one per beat, each ringed and ticked; one springs back; both pods answer ✓.

title: Let it draft the cards first.
body: blank-box-gets-cards · FELT close shot on the same blank card: this time a drafted stack arrives; the whale adds the one missing fact card and sends; pod ✓.

title: Hunches don't fit the slot.
body: lever-waits-for-evidence · The lever waits for evidence: the same lever ignores the speech card and moves only when a green test card seats.

title: When unsure, the gate stays shut.
body: fog-door-stays-shut · The fog door stays shut: the same door in the same fog no longer swings by itself, and a person opens it on purpose.

title: Every step gets a tick.
body: one-coin-after-crash · One coin after a crash: the same snapped line now ends with exactly one coin in the pod's fin.

title: Doing waits behind the gate.
body: envelope-waits-on-line · The envelope waits on the line: the same envelope that flew off now sits behind a shut gate until the whale reads it and sends it.

title: Five small gates, not one.
body: five-steady-lamps · Five steady lamps: the single wobbling ring is replaced by five crisp lamps in the same frame, and the right email passes.

title: First, check the ruler.
body: level-bar-after-calibration · The level bar: the same corner bar that leapt now stays level, because the ring was checked on a known card first.

title: Coin flips go to a person.
body: coin-caught-midair · The coin caught mid-air: the same coin toss no longer decides the payout, because the whale catches it before it lands.

title: Leave the flag where it is.
body: flag-not-paddle · A flag, not a paddle: at the same gap the whale plants a flag instead of smoothing it over, and the next pod gets through.

title: Every claim faces the same gates.
body: shelf-not-avalanche · A shelf, not an avalanche: the falling cards now meet the gates first, and the whale reads one card from a short shelf.

title: Readers pass a one-way gate.
body: fin-touches-glass · The fin touches glass: the same curious lean now meets glass instead of a lever, and the live line stays calm.

title: Every miss gets a new gate.
body: pod-answers-yes · The flag from the miss becomes the icon of a fourth gate. The backwards run stops there and is turned round, and the same pod now answers ✓.

title: Add a different gate.
body: swap-the-stack · The stacked identical gates from FELT peel apart into three gates of three kinds, and the same bug that passed them now stops.

title: Turn every miss into a gate.
body: flag-on-the-lintel · The printer pod prints the bar-2 sheet again and it comes out whole under a gate whose icon is the folded flag. The whale picks up the next flag.

title: The old bug hits a gate.
body: ghost-bounces · The old wobble swims back in exactly as in bar 2, hits the gate that was built from it, bounces off and dissolves. The pod answers ✓.

title: Fresh eyes try to break it.
body: fresh-poke-lands · The whale steps back from the line it checked twice. A fresh pod's poke lands on the gap with a tick, and another pod closes it.

title: Check the pin before the work.
body: pin-finds-home · An example card tests the bar-1 pin. It slides up to where the pod needed it, the line follows, and the pod answers ✓.

title: Find the first broken joint.
body: hop-to-the-joint · Instead of scrolling the whole run, the whale hops straight to the one glowing joint and fixes it. The pod answers ✓.

title: Show one real example.
body: show-me-one · The same pod hands over the same claim, now with an example in its socket. The whale tries it and its line mends.

title: Seven gates watch every frame.
body: smooth-turn · The same close take-off as bar 1 plays again, and the whale turns smoothly inside the turn gate's opening. The phone pod answers ✓.

title: Check the work, not its label.
body: label-peels-off · The same green-tagged run nears the same pod. The gate looks past the tag, the tag peels off, the line is fixed and the pod answers ✓.

title: Every answer keeps its receipt.
body: trace-back-trail · The same answer card as act 1, now with a tick and a glowing trail to its source. The whale follows it home before the customer acts.

title: Give every note a label.
body: tab-sort · The whale sorts its own summary by tab colour before sending it, so the guess that slipped through in act 1 is held back in plain sight.

title: Every step leaves a mark.
body: rewind-the-run · The whale scrubs the tick strip backwards like a tape, finds the one bad step and fixes it. The run replays clean.

title: Draw only the joins you see.
body: map-tells-truth · The same presentation as act 1, but the map now shows its gaps in copper, so the audience sees what is real before anyone falls through.

title: Test where the parts join.
body: clockwork-click · The same three pieces snap together, each join clicking behind its gate, and the line runs in step with the clock.

title: A gate after every step.
body: lanterns-down-the-line · Seen from the end where act 1 began, the line is a row of lit gates. The bad step is held at gate two, far from the reader.

title: Let the check only look.
body: still-water-report · The same report-reading shot as act 1, but the water behind the card is perfectly still. The report and the line match.

title: Some numbers get a pin.
body: hand-it-back-level · The same hand-over as act 1. This time the fin stays level, because the weight pin never moved through the redesign.

title: Start with the small card.
body: one-card-lift · The heap from act 1 is replaced by one small card; the pod lifts the key fact up from one layer down.

title: Three runs, one gate.
body: three-voices-one-note · The two mismatched cards of act 1 become three cards that slide into one, at one height, before the reader sees them.

title: Let the colours ring.
body: chord-before-send · The whale adds one more colour as in FELT, hears the chord shift, checks the page and swaps the card before sending. The pod answers ✓.

title: Keep the reading pair pinned.
body: back-row-reads · The FELT shot returns: bold new colours, the pins hold, and the back-row pod reads the slide and answers ✓.

title: Three parts, many songs.
body: rebuild-last-week · Asked again for last week's sound, the whale rebuilds it from the written list of cards and moves instead of the tangle, and the pod answers ✓.

title: Finished is when every gate opens.
body: glance-becomes-run · The FELT nod-and-ship moment is replaced by a run through the gate row. One flag is fixed, then the pod answers ✓.

title: Shrink it through the gates.
body: tab-stays-crisp · The whale drops the mark into the same tiny tab square as in FELT, and this time the one-stroke mark stays crisp. The pod answers ✓.

title: Draw the order as one line.
body: pods-follow-the-line · The whale tosses work exactly as in FELT, but the pods now follow the written arrow line, take turns, and all answer ✓.

title: Pull every thread into view.
body: bridge-card-found · The pod asks the same question as in FELT. This time the whale spins the sphere, finds the swollen bridge card at once, and the pod answers ✓.

title: Every shape gets one pin.
body: shelf-reveal · The FELT slides return with both circles meaning team, then the camera pulls back to reveal this film's own symbol shelf.

title: Taste, one tick at a time.
body: cards-rhyme · The FELT side-by-side returns, and the pod's card now rhymes with the sketch. The whale then keeps one deliberately odd card.

title: Every sound on the tick.
body: hits-stay-locked · The whale trims a shot as in FELT, but drags nothing. Every hit stays locked on its cut and the pod answers ✓.

title: Every frame lives on the line.
body: pause-anywhere · FELT framing returns. The whale taps pause at three random ticks in a row; each time the frame is clean and identical to its last visit. Spark.

title: Every join must hold.
body: stretch-stops-short · FELT framing returns. The whale starts to stretch the line, then stops at the length where every join is still teal; the pod receives it and answers ✓.

title: Two copies, one card.
body: two-cards-one-voice · FELT framing returns: the whale holds the script and screen cards; their words are identical; the pod quotes the screen and answers ✓.

title: Run the ring end to end.
body: far-end-lights · FELT framing returns. The ring sets off from the whale and travels all the way to the far end where the snap was; that stretch lights and holds; the pod answers ✓.

title: Nothing fake gets past the door.
body: no-hollow-boxes · FELT framing returns. The pod opens every card it receives and each one is full; behind the gate a small pile of hollow cards lies where they were stopped.

title: Turn each rule into a door.
body: scroll-becomes-gates · FELT framing returns. The whale holds up the scroll and it folds into a row of small gates on the line; the next line passes straight through; the pod answers ✓.

title: The old bug meets a door.
body: the-kink-stays-gone · FELT framing returns. The whale patches the kink; on the same beat as bar 2 the old kink tries to return and bounces off the gate; the line stays smooth; the pod answers ✓.

title: Lay the cards side by side.
body: two-chips-two-marks · FELT framing returns. The two pods hand over their cards; now two chips read ✓ and ✕; the whale builds on the good card and its line holds.

title: Every version gets a tick.
body: tug-and-tell · FELT framing returns: the two near-identical lines. The whale tugs one; its thread lights to the tick marked sent; the other stays dark; the pod quotes the lit one and answers ✓.

title: Put a ring on every turn.
body: same-turn-smooth · FELT framing returns. The whale makes the same turn as bar 1, now eased, with the ring inside its mark; the camera stays steady; the pod answers ✓.
